status: PROPOSED 2026-11-03, not approved: PLAN.md Phase 4 says the owner sets the pass threshold in advance. No report has been generated and no LLM has been called.
plan: PLAN.md Phase 4: an 8D incident report from a drift-table row, a groundedness check, an eval of 20 to 30 synthetic drift scenarios with known findings scored for correctness and groundedness with cost and latency per call, and a human review queue

scenarios.built_by: scripts/phase4_scenarios.py (cdm.scenarios), committed before any generator exists
scenarios.staged: all 30 are synthetic (staged): made-up scores run through the monthly job's own drift tests; no real image, patient or month is in them, and no number from them is ever reported as a drift result. The only real number used is the accuracy floor, a rule taken from the committed replay
scenarios.known_findings: cdm.scenarios.expected_findings(record): severity, overall alert, alerting skin types, new sources, containment, whether an 8D report is due (alerts only; PLAN.md: 'when the drift job flags'), whether delayed accuracy is available and whether it is below the lowest real in-distribution month (0.591), and the caveats a correct report must state; derived from the record and the rules, never typed by hand

model: Gemini, free tier (owner's decision 2026-11-03); the exact model ID is fixed in the generator PR before any live call
input: one scenario record (the same JSON shape as a gold_drift_monthly summary, with no ID, family, seed or finding in it) plus the fixed rules context in scenarios.json ('rules' and 'accuracy_floor'): the alert rule, the skin-type rule and caveat, the live-check and label-delay rules, the containment words and when an 8D report is written. Every known finding follows from these two inputs
output: JSON: structured findings in the same fields as the known findings (severity, overall_alert, alerting_skin_types, new_sources, containment, eight_d_report, delayed_accuracy_available, accuracy_drop, caveats), a list of numeric claims each naming the record field or rule it comes from, and, only when the month is in alert, an 8D report: problem, containment, root cause, permanent fix, verification, prevention (prose)

scoring.groundedness: every number in the report's prose and claims must match a value in its scenario record or in the fixed rules context (thresholds such as 0.01, 0.2, 0.1, 100 images, the 95th percentile and the accuracy floor; month numbers present in the record). Rounding and percent forms (0.14 as 14%) are fixed in the groundedness-check PR before any live call. A run with any unmatched number is ungrounded
scoring.correctness: the structured findings equal the known findings on every field, and every expected caveat is stated; an 8D report is written exactly when eight_d_report is true (warnings and no-drift months get findings only)
scoring.scenario_result: correctness: passes if at least 2 of its 3 runs are correct. Groundedness is a hard gate, not 2 of 3: one ungrounded number in any scored run fails the whole eval
scoring.provider_outage: a call that fails at the provider after retries (quota, timeout, 5xx) is an outage, not a wrong answer: it is counted apart and the run is not scored

thresholds_proposed.pass: at least 27 of 30 scenarios pass (90%) AND no scored run anywhere contains an ungrounded number
thresholds_proposed.inconclusive: more than 3 scenarios have fewer than 2 scored runs because of provider outages: reported as inconclusive (exit 2), never as a pass
thresholds_proposed.outage_scenarios_count_as: a scenario left without 2 scored runs (3 or fewer such scenarios) counts as not passed toward the 27

tracked_per_call: outcome: ok, outage or invalid output
dollar cost (0 on the free tier; tokens still recorded)
where_it_runs: a manual (workflow_dispatch) GitHub workflow in an Environment that needs the owner's approval; CI replays recorded responses and never calls an LLM (owner's instruction, 2026-11-03)
